name: Beef bibimbap bowl
steps: Season the ground beef with soy sauce and sesame oil, then brown it in a hot pan.
Saute the carrot and wilt the spinach separately with a pinch of salt.
Fry the egg sunny-side up in a little oil.
Pile the warm rice into a bowl and arrange the beef and vegetables on top.
Add the egg, spoon over the gochujang, and toss everything together before eating.
